label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Tolu, this was literally me last year 😭 I’m in Biology 100L now at a federal uni here in Lagos. I wrote JAMB in 2025, scored 251 and applied for Medicine and Surgery. They gave me Biology instead.

The day I saw it on my portal, I locked myself in my cousin’s room in Surulere and cried. I didn’t even eat. So when you say you’ve been crying since afternoon, I get it. You had a whole picture of how things would go and then the portal showed you something else. Please don’t let anybody make you feel ungrateful for being disappointed.

My mum was even still telling people in church that I was doing Medicine for like two months 😭 I had to beg her to stop. I know parents mean well sometimes, but it doesn’t make the pressure any less real.

Let me tell you what I know about transfer, then I’ll tell you how Biology has actually been for me.

**Transfer is real, but please don’t accept Biology thinking it will happen automatically.** Kingsley, I understand why you called it a myth if nobody you know moved, but it does happen. At the same time, favour, “just read hard” makes it sound much simpler than what our level adviser told us.

For my school, our adviser said you need a CGPA of **at least 4.5 out of 5 after 100L**, and there must also be space in Medicine. So even if you get the CGPA, it’s not a promise that you’ll be moved. She said about six people got moved into MBBS from the whole faculty last year, and she thinks over 40 people applied. I’m saying “about” because that’s how she gave us the numbers, not because I’ve seen the full list myself.

She also said you need to meet the Medicine cut-offs for **both JAMB and post-UTME**. Your 268 alone doesn’t tell us whether you qualify. I don’t know your school’s cut-offs or your post-UTME score, so please check both. And everything I’ve said is what our adviser told us about *my* school, not necessarily the rule at yours.

My own CGPA after first semester is 4.31. It’s not 4.5, and I’m still trying. I’m telling you that so you know I’m not somebody who has already transferred and is talking from the other side. I’m inside Biology now, doing my best, but I can’t tell you that reading hard guarantees the move.

Before you pay the acceptance fee, please go to the faculty or Biology department at **your own school** and ask them the exact rules. Ask what CGPA they require, whether there are JAMB and post-UTME cut-offs, how many spaces are usually available and how the application works. If you can, ask someone who actually handles transfers. Don’t just trust forum people, including me 😅 You still have the deadline to think about, so I’d try to find out as soon as possible.

As for Biology itself, it’s not a bad course. I honestly thought I would hate it because my mind was on Medicine, but I’ve been enjoying genetics and cell biology more than I expected.

Our 100L courses include BIO 101, CHM 101, PHY 101, MTH 101 and GST. For us, physics and maths are the ones dealing with people 😂 You still have to take the work seriously, especially if you’re aiming for that CGPA. There are also practical costs: my lab coat was ₦6,500, dissecting kit was ₦9,000, and the practical manual was extra. I don’t know what yours will cost, but it’s worth asking about that too.

Our first BIO practical, we dissected toads and one guy in my group fainted 😭 I was fine, and funny enough, that was the day I realised I actually like this thing. I’m not saying you’ll love dissecting toads too o, just that Biology has been more than the disappointment I first felt when I saw the admission.

On rewriting, I don’t think it’s wrong if Medicine is really what you want and you’re ready to try again. But staying at home is not always as easy as “one year is nothing.” My secondary school classmate Ifeoma rejected Pharmacy to rewrite for Medicine. She has written JAMB two more times and she’s still at home. That doesn’t mean the same thing will happen to you, but I think it’s fair to consider that rewriting can take longer than planned too.

Maybe also ask yourself honestly: **do you want to study Medicine, or do you mainly want to be “doctor” for your parents?** No judgement either way, family expectations can enter your head without you even noticing. But you’re the one who will study the course, so what *you* want matters.

I can’t choose for you, Tolu. If you accept Biology, please do it knowing transfer is possible but competitive, and that you might finish in Biology. If you rewrite, do it because you’ve thought about what another attempt could involve, not just because people are dismissing Biology.

Find out your school’s actual rules first, give yourself a little room to think, and please try to eat something ❤️ Whatever you choose, this is not the end of the world. I know it feels huge right now, but one portal result hasn’t finished your story.
